manus: One Rockstar boss's playthrough of GTA 6 took around 80 hours. That's Rob Nelson, co-head of Rockstar North. It included the full story, plus some optional goals. Leaks say the main story alone is about 50 hours, and doing everything could take up to 200. For comparison, GTA 5's story is about 30 hours, and Red Dead 2 is around 50 to 60. So GTA 6 could be Rockstar's longest yet. Follow for more GTA 6.
